question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51dffdfb8f7a682d52b050369661996264a1108fe95bdbb0ce7d102ffa700abc.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4af8433ac6c7d57b50b771bd4651e68773ca569ba666e2c48ba0cb02a73d0846.png] 

(3 + 2)² = 25 

5² = 25

25 = 25

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/968f68e2fb98bc35748b5a4befab36b1f2f4829c729e2fb67eecfab74a859448.png] 

(2 + 6)2 = 64 

82 = 64

64 = 64

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dd513eb7ba05a14f11fd7312640da729046de50cb605fae6c4cbfacb5b0af36.png] 

(5 + 4)2 = ? 

92 = ?

**81 = ?**

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
